Strategy: Penalize leftovers between forty-three and sixty, steering away from bins just above the good band toward either tight fills or very loose bins. It may help by sharpening the upper edge of the good band, but may fail by punishing leftovers that are actually useful.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) - (30 if r - item >= 43 and r - item <= 60 else 0) for r in bins]
```
